QuestInfo.name: [Masteria] The Keystone of Masteria
QuestInfo.0: Ask Taggrin if he knows a way to enter the Crimsonwood Keep.
QuestInfo.1: Taggrin says that you can obtain the Keystone of Masteria if you undertake the five trials of Crimsonwood Mountain. If you pass the trials, as the masters supposedly did, Crimsonwood's gates will be opened to you!
QuestInfo.2: You finally completed the Keystone of Masteria!

npc.0: 'If my recollections are correct, one would have to pass the 5 trials on Crimsonwood Mountain to gain entrance to the Keep.' That's what was written in Lireni's Log.
